verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents a managed, globally distributed model for its TURN media relay. TURN runs on Anycast, so clients automatically reach the nearest Cloudflare location and no regional servers or load balancers need to be deployed. The pack does not document how the SFU itself scales across nodes or regions; a community comment praising a Calls architecture writeup on scaling only indirectly suggests such material exists. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of SFU cascading or multi-node/region distribution, autoscaling behavior and capacity limits for the SFU media layer, independent hands-on corroboration of scaling.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, the vendor documents how the media layer scales across nodes or regions, whether managed autoscaling or self-hosted clustering

citations.quote: so you do not have to deploy regional TURN servers or load balancers
it _automatically_ connects to the Cloudflare location closest to them
